title: FLA import: decode audio bytes from Media N streams to populate SoundItem.dataUri
description:
## Problem

When importing a real Flash 8 .fla containing imported sounds, every sound library item is created as a stub with an empty `dataUri`. The audio data lives in "Media N" OLE2 streams (where N is the sound index number stored in the Contents stream). The import code knows about these—it even creates a `soundMediaIds` set to skip those streams during bitmap decoding—but never actually reads the audio bytes and populates `SoundItem.dataUri`.

Result: imported FLAs cannot play any sounds. The library shows the sound names but Test Movie plays silence.

## Evidence

`flash8-import.ts` line 801–825:
- Comment explicitly says "The actual audio data lives in 'Media N' streams which we do not decode yet"
- `soundMediaIds` set correctly identifies which Media N streams hold audio
- But the loop `continue`s past them without decoding

## What to implement

### 1. Detect audio bytes in Media N streams

Add audio sniffing alongside the existing bitmap sniffing in `media.ts` (or inline in flash8-import.ts). Audio magic bytes:
- MP3: `FF FB`, `FF F3`, `FF F2` (MPEG sync), or `49 44 33` (ID3 header)
- WAV: `52 49 46 46` (RIFF header)
- OGG: `4F 67 67 53` (OggS)

### 2. Extract raw bytes → data URI

For recognized audio magic, encode as `data:audio/mpeg;base64,...` (MP3) or `data:audio/wav;base64,...` (WAV). No decompression needed — these bytes are already raw audio files inside the Media N stream.

### 3. Wire into buildFla8Document

In the sound-stub loop (around line 800), after creating the `SoundItem` stub, look up `streams.get(`Media ${num}`)` and call the new audio sniffer. If successful, set `soundItem.dataUri` and infer `compressionType` ("mp3" / "raw") from the magic bytes. Update `SoundItem.sampleRate`, `isStereo`, `sampleSize` where determinable from the audio header.

### 4. Acceptance criteria

- Unit test in `flash8-import.test.ts`: build a synthetic `streams` map with a `Contents` referencing sound #3 and a `Media 3` entry holding minimal MP3 bytes (e.g., 4-byte ID3 header). Assert the resulting `SoundItem.dataUri` starts with `data:audio/mpeg;base64,`.
- Publish a SWF from a doc produced by the FLA import and verify the DefineSound tag has non-empty audio data.

## Files

- `packages/core/src/fla/flash8-import.ts` — main change (sound-media decode loop)
- `packages/core/src/fla/media.ts` — add `decodeMediaAudio(bytes)` helper
- `packages/core/src/fla/__tests__/flash8-import.test.ts` — new unit tests
